memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Epilepsy
  - Status: On levetiracetam 500 mg BD and lamotrigine 50 mg BD, seizure-free for past 6 months.
  - Plan: Continue current regimen; check serum sodium and creatinine today.
- Hypertension
  - Status: On amlodipine 5 mg OD, telmisartan 40 mg OD, losartan 50 mg OD, hydrochlorothiazide 12.5 mg OD; BP today 138/86 mmHg.
  - Plan: Add low‑salt diet advice; recheck BP in 4 weeks.
- Weight 78 kg, waist circumference 92 cm (male cut‑off 90 cm) – slightly elevated.
- Diet advice: Breakfast – whole grain toast with egg white; Lunch – vegetable‑rich khichdi with limited oil; Dinner – grilled fish with steamed vegetables.
- Due: HbA1c repeat on 2025-07-05 (3 months).

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I have felt occasional light‑headedness when I stand up quickly, especially after mornings. No loss of consciousness. My seizures remain under control.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: EEG: Awake and sleep records show no epileptiform discharges. Background activity normal for age. No focal slowing. Study supports continued seizure control on current medication.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Referral to Cardiovascular Medicine, Narayana Health, Bengaluru. Reason: Persistent hypertension despite four‑drug regimen; need specialist review for possible secondary causes and device‑based therapy.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Cardiology review completed. Secondary work‑up negative. Advised to add spironolactone 25 mg OD and consider renal denervation if BP remains >140/90 after 3 months. Continue current agents; monitor potassium.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Follow‑up appointment booked with Dr Karthik Hegde (D04) for 2026-01-20 at 10:30 AM. Patient to bring recent BP log and medication list.
